steps: Steam cooked carrot until very tender, about 8 minutes, then mash until smooth with a fork.
Mince the garlic clove finely and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the mashed carrot, ricotta, parmesan, and minced garlic.
Add the egg, rice flour, and fresh dill; stir until a soft, cohesive batter forms.
Heat olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat, about 170 °C (340 °F).
Drop heaped tablespoons of batter into the skillet and flatten gently into 7 cm rounds.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and set through with no raw centre.
Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel. Keep refrigerated up to 2 days or freeze up to 1 month.
